blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Improving the learning gains that the Philippines has made, as evidenced by its performance in the 2025 Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA), would need the stronger and more active participation of local government units, Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a Department of Education (DepEd) statement issued on Friday. “LGUs played a crucial role, from the provincial, city, and municipal levels down to our barangays,” Angara said, referring to the country’s improved performance in the 2025 PISA. “They coordinated with schools to ensure good testing conditions, including standby generators, medical personnel, and other learner support.
